description: a strong broad-shouldered young woman with a long dark braid falling from under the helmet, in dark blackened steel plate armour engraved with bright copper lightning bolts, a grey wolf fur cloak over the shoulders, a dark steel helmet with two curved aurochs horns, copper-trimmed gauntlets and dark steel boots, a long broad sword with a copper hilt sheathed at the hip and a round dark shield with a copper lightning sign on the back, sitting astride and riding in the pose of the grey mannequin, both hands in front holding the reins, seen from the side, facing right, only the near leg showing, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the foot inside the image, nothing under the rider, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
